hover_control_response.comment: - Conditions: gross weight 13000 lb, aft CG, hover response unless the source table notes otherwise. - Sensitivity values are listed with SCAS off; damping is listed with SCAS both off and on. - These are condition-specific response figures, not universal constants or complete control laws. - The supplied NotebookLM table did not provide additional numerical response values beyond those already stored here.
